This is evidence of buildable replacement capacity, not yet demonstrated reliable freight service: this session found no primary public record of loaded voyages, schedule completion, uptime, charger availability, freight completed or diesel actually displaced.

inherited_tests.confirmation: Obtain a dated operator or port record for one named route showing loaded departures and arrivals, TEU or tonnes carried, scheduled versus actual completion, charging or battery-swap availability, maintenance downtime and diesel use avoided over a defined interval.

inherited_tests.ordinary_control: A newly delivered diesel ship also does not prove reliable scheduled service; delivery language should be tested against later voyage records in either propulsion category.
